channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 07
item.description:
7 development commits

Monuments & World

  • Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.

Bug Fixes

  • Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
  • DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 06
item.description:
59 development commits

Equipment & Wearables

  • Night Vision Goggles no longer get stuck and their glow is restored on scientists' suits after trophy head removal.
  • Flamethrower fuel gauge now accurately tracks fuel level and includes a wobble animation for readability.

Environment & Visuals

  • Elongated distance flares added and overly bright Floating City flares dimmed for better visibility.

Deployables & Respawn

  • Players can no longer respawn on sleeping bags placed in overly tight spaces; placement restrictions and a warning toast have been added.

Crafting, Inventory & UI

  • Disabled blueprint tooltip now shows "cannot learn" for clearer feedback.
  • Watercatcher and chicken coop loot panels correctly select the bucket when it is in the belt.
  • Backpack contents are now counted for mission items, tech tree unlocks, vending machines and other required‑item checks.

Gameplay & Stability

  • Shutter frames now correctly reflect their state when entering network range, preventing doors from appearing open or closed incorrectly.
  • Fixed map reload issues that could cause invalid level unloading order, improving stability when reloading maps (e.g., Craggy).
  • Resolved a rare client crash caused by BasePlayer.SendPingsToClient null reference, reducing disconnects.
  • Prevented crashes when network LOD processes destroyed entities, ensuring smoother gameplay for players with disconnected boats.
  • Fixed recurring null reference errors from PlayerBoat wake effects when boats are destroyed, stopping error spam and potential lag.
  • Cleaned up map loading by removing leftover networkable objects after a map load, reducing post‑load glitches.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Nov 05
item.description:
51 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed boat scientists staying locked onto hidden targets longer than necessary.
  • Fixed roaming boat groups sometimes not properly attacking players on the beach.
  • Fixed NPCEncounterTimer error that could prevent NPC encounters from triggering.

Vehicles & Boat Events

  • Fixed stolen PT boats being removed when the roaming boat event ends; only empty boats are cleaned up now.
  • Forced coast runs to work properly, ensuring scientist boat groups drive along the shore in formation during the event.

Inventory & Items

  • Fixed backpack slot 7 bug where moving items was incorrectly treated as equipping or unequipping a backpack.

Game Modes

  • Fixed supply drops in Primitive mode missing blueprint pages.

Server Browser

  • Favorites and history now list reliably, with immediate IP:port saving, DNS‑failure fallback, and no "No servers found" flash while loading.

Social

  • Contact list notes are saved correctly, letting players attach personal notes to friends.

Demo System

  • Demo names longer than 15 characters no longer overflow in the UI.
  • Demo export is no longer capped at 240 fps and low timescale values (< 0.2) no longer cause stutter, resulting in smoother playback.

Visual Effects

  • Distance flares now render with correct brightness, fixing blown‑out flares and improving distant visibility.
